messages:
Nadia (PM): Quick spot from QA: several 'Docs' links in the Console sidecar take users to the docs home instead of the specific setting. Support getting confusion tickets.

Ravi (Design): Yep — the links are generic. We should deep-link to anchors. On mobile the anchored heading gets hidden under the sticky header.

Leah (Docs): Our generator makes anchors from headings which change when we tweak copy. We should add explicit IDs for stable anchors.

Evan (SRE): If we add explicit IDs, please follow kebab-case. Also ensure the docs CDN preserves the fragment identifier.

Maya (Support): Can we standardize naming? Console says "Help", docs say "Documentation". Users ask which to click.

Leah (Docs): Proposal: UI label = "Docs" (short), site title = "Redwood Console docs". I'll submit a lexicon PR.

Ravi (Design): UX details: when scrolling to anchor add a 72px offset and focus the heading (tabindex="-1" + focus()) so SR users land correctly. Smooth scroll helps reduce perceived jump.

Evan (SRE): Backend note: add a small API `/api/docs/anchor-snippet?page=console&anchor=rate-limits` returning a short excerpt so the sidecar popover can show context without loading the entire page. Cache TTL 6h. Return 404 if anchor not found.

Maya (Support): If 404, show toast: "Section moved  opening Console docs home" with a link to search. Include keyboard dismiss.

LinkBot: Action created: docs-anchors (Leah), anchor-snippet-api (Evan), ui-scroll-offset (Ravi), support-kb-links (Maya).

Leah (Docs): I'll add stable IDs to the most-linked pages and include a redirect table for renamed anchors. Will add examples of canonical links like `https://docs.redwood.inference/console/usage#rate-limits` in the PR.

Ravi (Design): I'll prototype the offset + popover microcopy tomorrow.

Nadia (PM): Nice. Can someone add a QA checklist item: pick 3 deep links and verify landing + SR announcement (desktop & mobile)? Assign to me and QA.

Evan (SRE): I'll put up the API branch and mock responses for design to iterate.

Maya (Support): I'll draft the KB snippet once Leah confirms canonical format.

Nadia (PM): Thanks team — ping when PRs are up and I'll schedule the patch release.
